messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
For how long does the UR5e manual say to wait after powering the robot off to let it cool down before handling it?

response.text: Per quanto tempo il manuale dell'UR5e indica di attendere dopo aver spento il robot, per farlo raffreddare prima di maneggiarlo?
